title: Synchronizing web frontend types and columns with Python backend via web/gen
answers: How are TypeScript types and options generated from Python in mitmweb?
What files need to change when adding or modifying mitmproxy options in web UI?
How to update frontend test fixtures after modifying Flow or BackendState in Python?
How are FlowTable columns kept in sync with mitmproxy backend?
body:
Several TypeScript modules and test fixtures in `web/src/js/` are derived from Python models using generator scripts in `web/gen/`. Run `web/gen/all` (or individual scripts) when changing backend definitions:
- `web/gen/options_js.py` generates `web/src/js/ducks/_options_gen.ts` from `mitmproxy.options`.
- `web/gen/backend_consts.py` generates `web/src/js/backends/consts.ts` from mode definitions (`ReverseMode`).
- `web/gen/state_js.py` generates mock state `web/src/js/__tests__/ducks/_tbackendState.ts`.
- `web/gen/tflow_js.py` generates test flow fixtures `web/src/js/__tests__/ducks/_tflow.ts`.
- `web/gen/web_columns.py` extracts table columns from `web/src/js/components/FlowTable/FlowColumns.tsx` into Python `mitmproxy/tools/web/web_columns.py`.
In addition, `web/src/js/flow.ts:Flow` must be manually kept in sync with serialization in `mitmproxy/tools/web/app.py`.
applies: Applies when modifying mitmproxy options, capture mode specifications, flow schemas, or flow table columns in Python or TypeScript.

history.prevBody:
When adding or modifying flow table columns in mitmweb, changes must stay in sync across:
1. Column definitions in `web/src/js/components/FlowTable/FlowColumns.tsx`.
2. Run generator `web/gen/web_columns.py:extract_columns` to update `mitmproxy/tools/web/web_columns.py:AVAILABLE_WEB_COLUMNS`.
3. Verified by `test/mitmproxy/tools/web/test_app.py:test_generated_files` (which asserts `web_columns.py` matches code generator output) and `test/mitmproxy/tools/web/test_web_columns.py`.

says: New settings and column definitions do not match between the web UI and backend.
The traffic list table is missing newly added data columns in the web dashboard.
Web interface displays outdated configuration options that do not match the current proxy capabilities.
Synchronize traffic table columns and configuration choices in the web dashboard with backend updates.
